competency_statement_fil: TESDA BHS NC II — Participate in Workplace Communication: kinikilala ng BHW kung sinong ugnayan sa lugar ng trabaho ang dapat kausapin, at bakit, batay sa uri ng pangangailangan.
competency_statement_en: TESDA BHS NC II — Participate in Workplace Communication: the BHW recognizes which workplace relationship to engage, and why, based on the kind of need at hand.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Nasasabi ng BHW, nang hindi tumitingin sa listahan, ang apat na taong/grupong kinakausap niya sa gawain (komunidad, midwife/RHU, barangay officials, kapwa BHW).
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW states, without looking at a list, the four people/groups they engage with in their work (community, midwife/RHU, barangay officials, fellow BHWs).
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Naaalala lamang ang isa o dalawa sa apat, o naiiba ang paglalarawan kapag hindi tinitingnan ang materyal.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Only recalls one or two of the four, or the description falls apart without looking at the material.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Nasasabi agad ang apat nang tama, walang tulong o untag.
levels.kaya_na_en: States all four correctly right away, with no prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nasasabi ang tatlo sa apat, pero kailangan pa ng untag para sa ika-apat.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: States three of the four, but needs a prompt for the fourth.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Dalawa pababa lang ang naaalala kahit may untag.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Recalls two or fewer even with prompting.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ng BHW, gamit ang sariling salita, na ang kanilang tungkulin ay may legal na batayan (RA 7883) at sila ay akreditado ng local health board.
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW explains, in their own words, that their duty has a legal basis (RA 7883) and that they are accredited by the local health board.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Naiiba ang paliwanag sa 'boluntir lang kasi gusto kong tumulong' nang walang binanggit na legal na batayan o proseso ng akreditasyon.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: The explanation stays at 'I just volunteer because I want to help,' with no mention of a legal basis or accreditation process.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapaliwanag nang tama at may kumpiyansa, kahit hindi tinatanong.
levels.kaya_na_en: Explains it correctly and confidently, even unprompted.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naaalala lang kapag may untag na tanong ('saan ba galing ang tungkulin mo?').
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Only recalls it when prompted ('where does your duty come from?').
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi maiugnay ang tungkulin sa anumang legal na batayan.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Cannot connect the duty to any legal basis at all.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Wastong itinuturo ng BHW kung sinong ugnayan (komunidad, midwife/RHU, barangay officials, kapwa BHW) ang dapat lapitan, batay sa uri ng suportang kailangan.
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW correctly identifies which relationship (community, midwife/RHU, barangay officials, fellow BHW) to approach, based on the kind of support needed.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Palaging iisang tao lamang (kadalasan ang midwife) ang itinuturo kahit hindi klinikal ang usapin.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Consistently points to the same person (usually the midwife) even when the matter isn't clinical.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tama ang tugon sa lahat ng ipinakitang sitwasyon, mabilis at walang pag-aalinlangan.
levels.kaya_na_en: Responds correctly to every situation shown, quickly and without hesitation.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama sa halos lahat pero kailangan ng dagdag na tanong bago makapili.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct on most, but needs a follow-up question before choosing.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Palaging iisang tao lang ang isinusulong anuman ang sitwasyon.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Always defaults to the same person regardless of the situation.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ng BHW kung ano ang mangyayari kung hindi gagamitin ang tamang ugnayan (hal. pagkaantala ng serbisyo, sobrang abala sa midwife).
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW explains what happens when the wrong relationship is used (e.g., delayed service, an overloaded midwife).
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nasasabi lamang na 'mahalaga silang lahat' nang walang kongkretong halimbawa ng epekto kapag hindi ito ginamit nang tama.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Only says 'they're all important' with no concrete example of what goes wrong when it's misused.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May kongkretong halimbawa ang ibinibigay para sa bawat ugnayan kung bakit ito mahalaga.
levels.kaya_na_en: Gives a concrete example for each relationship explaining why it matters.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May pangkalahatang paliwanag pero kulang sa kongkretong halimbawa.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Gives a general explanation but lacks a concrete example.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi maipaliwanag kung bakit mahalaga bukod sa 'kailangan lang.'
levels.hindi_pa_en: Cannot explain why it matters beyond 'it's just needed.'
